**Summary:**

I identified that the pricing-engine crash loop is caused by invalid pricing rules data, not a Kubernetes issue. Both pods crash with an identical panic when compiling rule "BF-2026-STACKED" due to an array index out of bounds error - the rule declares 3 tiers but attempts to access the 4th tier. The fix is to review and correct the BF-2026-STACKED rule configuration in rules-admin; once fixed, Kubernetes will automatically restart the pods and they'll load the corrected rules.
